title: Fix Hero service line naming and ensure 'sofa cleaning near me' is visible on-page

requirements.text: Update the Hero headline’s second line so the service names are explicitly aligned with the Services section offerings, replacing the generic text "Carpet, Mattress & AC Services" with wording that clearly references Carpet Cleaning, Mattress Cleaning, and AC Water Jet Service (English-only).

acceptanceCriteria: On the landing page Hero, the second line under the main headline no longer reads "Carpet, Mattress & AC Services".
The updated Hero service line explicitly names the services in a way that matches the Services section offerings (Carpet Cleaning, Mattress Cleaning, AC Water Jet Service).
No CTA destinations are changed (tel:+918000262644 and https://wa.me/918000262644 remain exactly the same).

requirements.text: Ensure the exact phrase "sofa cleaning near me" appears as visible, user-facing on-page marketing copy (English-only), in a natural, non-spammy way, and is not removed during the service-line update.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact phrase "sofa cleaning near me" appears in visible page content (not only in metadata).
The phrase is present after the Hero service-line update is applied.
No page sections are removed and no CTA destinations are changed.

constraints: Do not change any existing CTA destinations or contact links (tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, Instagram link, Google Business Profile link).
Frontend immutable paths must not be edited (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
nonGoals: Do not add new sections, new services, or change service pricing.
Do not introduce any AI-related features or chat widgets.
Do not change branding assets, images, or overall page layout beyond the requested text updates.
